name: Shenzhou 5
about: Shenzhou 5 (2003-045A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 2003 Oct 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2003 Oct 15), held fixed
GCAT names the site (Zhongguo) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
